annotation.title_clean: Does Artificial Intelligence threaten decent work?
annotation.title_en: Does Artificial Intelligence threaten decent work?
annotation.venue: ILO Voices – The Future of Work Podcast
annotation.summary_en: ILO Future of Work podcast episode 43 (19 July 2023) page, linked to the 8th Regulating for Decent Work Conference. It asks how generative AI such as ChatGPT affects jobs and how to make sure AI supports decent work, equity and social justice rather than undermining them. The page has no content specific to robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Generative AI such as ChatGPT has made the effects of technology on work more urgent
Commentators are split between predictions of mass job loss and AI taking over mundane tasks
The episode asks how AI can support poverty reduction, equity, decent work and social justice
Links to the 8th Regulating for Decent Work Conference and to research on regulating AI at work and algorithmic management
